english:
God uncreated. Likewise, also after the [hymns of] Mercy (Oghormya)
at the Liturgy, Tone 1 [ah]: Today being. With its proper [canons].
Morning song: "Lord, You brought [me] up."
Proclamation: "Let us glorify."
"Holy God," who wast crucified.
At the [hymns of] the Youth (Mankunk), Tone 8 [dk], melody [steghi]:
"Jesus, Only-begotten."
Proclamation: "For peace."
Prayer: "Holy art Thou, Lord." After
the prayer, Psalm 29 [30]: "Lord, You brought up," response: "I will exalt."
Proverbs [Wisdom] 10:9: "Wisdom [delivered] her servants," to verse 20: "Your holy name."
The Epistle, 1 Thessalonians
4:12 [13]: "I would not have you ignorant, brethren," to verse 17 [18]: "with these words."
Alleluia: "He brought me out."
Gospel, John 11:1: "Now a certain man was sick,"
to verse 54: "together with His disciples." After this:
"Of the Souls" (Hogvots): "The Lord after creation." Proclamation:
"Let us ask." Prayer: "To Your almighty
and wonderful dominion."
Midday Introit: "The falling asleep of Lazarus," and "When He came."
Hymn, Tone 5 [gdz]: "Who didst descend from heaven."
Psalm 29 [30]: "Lord, You brought up."
Proverbs 14:27: "The fear of the Lord," to verse 35: "destroys the wise."
The Epistle, 1
Thessalonians 4:12 [13]: "I would not have you ignorant, brethren," to verse 17 [18]:
"with these words." Alleluia: "He brought me out."
Gospel, John 11:55: "And the passover was nigh," to chapter 12:11: "and believed
in Jesus."
Hymn of the Thrice-Holy (Srbasatsutyun): "For remembrance."
But in the evening: "Bow down [Your ear]" and
"Deliver [me]." "Gladsome Light." Messedi: Of the Coming.
Proclamation: "Let us say."
"Holy God," who didst come and art to come.
And the priests shall vest together and go out into the chancel (atyán)
with cross and Gospel, with incense and candles.
Hymn of the Ascent (Hambartsi), Tone 1 [adz]: "Who art praised above."
At the beginning, they shall open the curtain. Proclamation:
"Let us ask with faith." Prayer: "King of
Peace."

***

Canons of the Coming of Christ our God
upon the colt to Jerusalem.
Palm Sunday (Tsakhkazard). In the night,
there is a vigil, and they shall place the Holy Sacrament upon the cushion.
Processional hymn (Hetevak sharakan), Tone 5 [gdz]: "Being King," sing the four verses together.
Blessing (Orhnutyun), Tone 1 [adz]: "Who art praised above," sing in the chancel (atyán).
Inquiries (Harts), Tone 6 [gky]: "Who art in the cherubic."
The Myrrhbearers' Gospel: only of the burial, as on the past
Sunday; and after: "All the days of my life."
And during the "Lord of Heaven" (Ter herknits) hymn: they shall vest together and go out
into the chancel (atyán) with cross and Gospel and all ornaments.
Morning song:
"Today He enters." Proclamation: "Let us say."
"Holy God," who didst come and art to come.
Hymn, Tone 1 [adz]: "Who art praised above." After this:
Psalm 97 [98]: "Let the hills sing together," response: "Sing
praises to the Lord."
Scripture: Song of Solomon 2:8:
"The voice of my beloved," to chapter 6:11: "there will I give my breasts to you." (This from the Song of Songs is gathered from here and there).
Prophecy: Isaiah 62:11: "Say to the daughter of Zion," to
verse 12: "and not forsaken."
Epistle: Ephesians 1:3:
"Blessed be God," to verse 10: "upon the earth in Him."
Alleluia: "Blessed is He that cometh in the name of the Lord."
Gospel, Mark 10:46: "And they came to Jericho," to chapter 11:11: "together with the twelve."
And they shall bless the four corners of the world (Andastan). After this, Proclamation: "By Your Holy Cross."
Prayer: "Protect [us]."
And they shall go to the tombs.
Introit: "When He came." Hymn, Tone 8 [dk]: "The Only-Begotten Jesus,"
Glory to the Mother of God and to the Cross. Psalm
129 [130] in tone, Antiphon: "Let Your ears be attentive," response: "Out of the depths have I cried."
Gospel, John 11:1: "Now a certain man was sick," to
verse 46: "which Jesus had done."
After this: "Rest of the souls."
And then they shall begin the hymn, Tone 4 [bk]: "Today with the fiery ones." After this:
"Newly-created," sing only the two verses.
Proclamation: "Let us ask." Prayer: "To Your almighty."
Midday Introit: "Rejoice, O Jerusalem." Psalm: "The Lord reigneth."
Hymn, Tone 8 [dk]: "Without beginning." Psalm 97 [98]: "Let the hills sing together," response: "Sing praises."
Scripture: Song of Solomon 1:1: "Let him kiss me," to chapter 2:3: "in my throat."
Prophet: Zechariah 9:9: "Rejoice greatly," to verse 15: "He shall protect them."
Epistle: Philippians 4:4: "Rejoice," to verse 7: "and your minds in Christ Jesus."
Alleluia: "O Lord our God, appear..."
